home.seoTitle: Homeopathy with Natasa | Homeopath in London
home.seoDescription: Nataša Perić, PhD, homeopath in private practice in London since 2009. Online consultations by video, and in person in Telegraph Hill by arrangement.
home.introTitle: Your experience of health is uniquely yours.
home.introBody: I believe that we know our bodies better than anyone, and I encourage you to share your perspectives with me. I take the time to listen, ask thoughtful questions and aim to understand the bigger picture. Your symptoms, circumstances and responses are individual to you. I want to understand what you are experiencing, what has brought you here, and the connections within your health story.
home.scientistBody: The many paths I have explored have shaped the way I practise homeopathy. My background in biological sciences and human physiology, research, education and motherhood have all influenced who I am as a homeopathic practitioner. I've gathered different perspectives, practical tools and wisdom along the way, and they continue to influence how I work with patients.

quotes.text: I can't thank Natasa enough for her patience, support and guidance. She is very professional and has a wealth of knowledge. Natasa is a kind and understanding person, truly dedicated to helping people, always offering extra or follow-ups when needed. I would absolutely recommend her to others.
quotes.author: Patient, London

quotes.text: I have been so extremely impressed with Natasa's attention to care and compassion towards the many different aspects of my life.
quotes.author: Patient, London

quotes.text: Natasa is genuine, creative and compassionate. She has supported me through one of the most difficult transitions in my life. I have tremendous respect for her knowledge and feel privileged to have her as my homeopath.
quotes.author: Patient, London

home.closingTitle: If this feels like the kind of care you are looking for
home.closingBody: It is important to find the right person to work with. I'd like to meet you and explore together what might be most helpful for you. You can book a consultation directly, or if you have a question first, you're welcome to write to me.
home.holisticTitle: Would you like to explore your health in a holistic way?
home.holisticBody:
I see the body not as a machine that simply breaks down, but as a living, intelligent system with an innate wisdom and the ability to respond and find balance and harmony.

Wellbeing involves more than physical health, and health is not just about treating individual symptoms. It is about understanding the whole person and creating the conditions that may support the body's own capacity for balance, adaptation and change. You have more resources within you than you may realise, and homeopathy is the approach I use to support them.

At the heart of my practice are two beliefs: that a diagnosis doesn't define you, and that the body has a remarkable capacity to respond when given the support it needs.
home.quoteLine: What if feeling well isn't something to chase, but something to come back to?

about.seoTitle: About Nataša Perić | Homeopath in London since 2009
about.seoDescription: Nataša Perić, PhD in Natural Sciences, homeopath in private practice in London since 2009 and supervisor at the Centre for Homeopathic Education.
about.title: About Natasa

sections.heading: Unexpected beginnings
sections.body:
I developed a passion for homeopathy following the birth of my son, when I was given homeopathic medicine for several postpartum problems, including depression. When my son was six months old, I sought help from a homeopath and was astonished by how quickly I responded to the treatment. Not only did my depression lift and my vitality return, but I experienced a surge of love and bonding with my son. Little did I know that the effects of a traumatic birth had been directly impacting our bonding and my mental and emotional wellbeing.

This experience sparked my fascination with homeopathy and changed my life. It motivated me to fully understand how I had been able to heal, and less than a year later I decided to change my profession and study homeopathy on a BSc course at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, the largest homeopathic college in the UK.

I bridged my interests in holistic health and medicine with my knowledge of science. During my four year homeopathy training at CHE, I immersed myself in the advanced study of homeopathic theory and philosophy, methodology and research, learning from excellent teachers who offered a range of styles and wisdom. All of this was instrumental in helping me develop strong clinical practice. I am honoured to now be a lecturer and tutor at CHE, working alongside the very homeopaths and teachers who trained me.

sections.heading: How I work
sections.body:
I am committed to delivering the highest quality service to all my patients and helping you explore the healing power of natural remedies. I work with you in partnership, with the intention of helping you feel good and connect with your creative potential.

Listening carefully and mindfully is important to me, as is appreciating your uniqueness and your relationships with yourself, others and the world around you.

I walk my talk, having personally explored and experienced natural healing and homeopathy, optimal nutrition, tapping, yoga and mindfulness. I guide you with your individual healing plan and share the practical tools and resources I've used myself.

sections.heading: Teaching and supervision
sections.body: I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, where I lead the Research Proposition module. Supervision keeps me in contact with how the next generation of practitioners is being trained, and it keeps my own thinking honest.

about.closingBody: The first consultation is long and unhurried. It is the best way to find out whether this way of working suits you.
about.credentialsIntro: I've practised homeopathy since I qualified in 2009, both in London and in my homeland, Croatia. Alongside my private homeopathy practice, I lecture and supervise students at the Centre for Homeopathic Education, the largest homeopathy college in the UK.

homeopathy.seoTitle: What homeopathy is | Homeopathy with Natasa, London
homeopathy.seoDescription: Homeopathy treats the body as one integrated system rather than isolated organs. What a consultation is like, what it may support, and how remedies are sent.
homeopathy.title: Homeopathy
homeopathy.standfirst: A type of medicine that treats the body as one unique integrated system, in order to identify the root cause of symptoms.
homeopathy.whatBody: Conventional medicine has become very good at studying organs separately. The heart, the gut, the skin, the hormones: each one is studied on its own and treated by a different specialty. That division is useful, and it is also why a person with several connected symptoms can end up with several separate explanations and no single one.
homeopathy.whatBody2: Homeopathy starts from the other end. It treats the body as one unique integrated system, and it reads symptoms as expressions of that whole system rather than as separate faults. The aim is to identify the root cause rather than to quieten each symptom in turn. The remedy is chosen for you as an individual, and the body is gently stimulated to heal itself.
notItems: It is not a replacement for your doctor. Please keep your medical care, and please tell me about it.
It is not mystical. I am a former research scientist and I speak plainly about what is known and what is not.
It is not fast. Longstanding patterns rarely shift quickly, and I will not pretend otherwise.
It is not passive. You are an active part of this, and what you notice between sessions matters.
homeopathy.promiseTitle: What I can and cannot promise
homeopathy.promiseBody: I do not give promises. I give you my full expertise and knowledge, and what happens next also depends on you: what you do with it, your own vital force, your lifestyle, and everything else that affects healing. What I offer instead of a promise is an educational dialogue. I explain how homeopathy works, and I give you an honest indication of what is realistic, given what you are living with and how long it has been there.
homeopathy.supportTitle: What people come to me with
homeopathy.supportIntro: People come to me at many different points. Most often they are living with something that has continued for a long time and has been looked at in pieces. Homeopathy may support the person as a whole while that is going on. I do not make claims about outcomes for named conditions.
supportItems: Hormonal changes across different stages of life
Low energy and exhaustion that has no clear explanation
Recurrent complaints that keep returning in the same pattern
Sleep, tension and states of mind that sit alongside physical symptoms
Wanting support during a demanding period rather than treatment for one thing
homeopathy.remediesBody: Consultations are currently held online by video, and your remedies are posted to you. They are prepared by an established homeopathic pharmacy and sent to your address in the UK, usually arriving within a few days. If you are outside the UK we will agree the arrangement together before your consultation. Homeopathic medicines are included in the consultation fee, except for acute consultations and detox therapies. Postage is charged separately.
homeopathy.remediesBody2: You will always receive written instructions. If anything is unclear afterwards, write to me. I would rather answer a short question than have you guessing.
homeopathy.askBody: Honesty and openness, including about the things that feel small or awkward. Patience, because this is gradual. And that you stay in touch between sessions if something changes. In return you have my full attention, my time, and a straight answer whenever I have one.
consultationBody: My belief is that health should never be a one-size-fits-all approach; it is unique to each person.

Homeopathy is personalised medicine. Each of us is unique in our genetic make up, physiology and reaction to our environments, and each other. What causes illness in one person is not the same for another, and treatment will therefore differ accordingly.
Every detail of your health history is interconnected like a web. Everything is a clue to your present state of health, and I want to know it all.

During your first consultation, we will discuss your current health concerns, overall health, lifestyle, stress management and nutrition, as well as your past medical history, health goals and any medications or supplementation that you may be taking.
We will explore the root causes of your symptoms together, and I will outline what we need to do to help you feel well again.
interestBody: I have a particular interest in working in the areas of women's health, and mental and emotional healing, all through the teens, pregnancy and birthing, mothering and menopause and beyond.

My areas of special interest include stress, anxiety and low mood, immunity, hormonal health including adrenal, thyroid and hormonal contraception related concerns, and behavioural difficulties in children.

consultations.title: Consultations
consultations.standfirst: Online by Google Meet video, wherever you are.
consultations.intro:
I don't see you simply as a diagnosis or a collection of isolated symptoms. I want to understand the person experiencing them: your story, your circumstances, your patterns, and your individual experience.

Homeopathy with me is a process, rather than a quick fix. Together, we explore your health concerns and the circumstances surrounding them. I work alongside you to make sense of your experiences and understand what may have contributed to them.

My work complements rather than replaces conventional medical care.
consultations.bookingNote:
Please book your online appointment with me here. Appointments take place by Google Meet video. Times are listed on the 24 hour clock (e.g. 13:00 is 1pm). If you are not in GMT/BST, set your time zone first to see appointment times in your time zone. Payment is on booking, and secures your appointment.

If you don't see a time that suits you or I am fully booked, please email me at hello@homeopathywithnatasa.co.uk. I usually have availability if you need to see me urgently.
expectItems: Plenty of time to talk about everything that is troubling you.
A confidential space and a warm, non-judgemental listener.
A clear treatment plan, sometimes including additional holistic recommendations.
An explanation of the homeopathic approach and what to expect from your course of treatment.
consultations.availabilityBody: Consultations take place online via Google Meet, and I can accommodate clients across different time zones. If you have any questions about this, please feel free to get in touch.

privacy.seoDescription: How Nataša Perić collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: Who I am
sections.body: I am Nataša Perić, a homeopath in private practice, working online by video and in person in Telegraph Hill, south east London, by arrangement. I decide how the information described here is used. My email address is in the footer of every page, and it is the best way to reach me about anything on this page.

sections.heading: What I collect
sections.body: Your name, email address and anything you choose to tell me when you write to me, use the contact form or book an appointment. If you become a client, I also hold the health information you share with me during consultations, together with my case notes, the remedies selected and the postal address remedies are sent to.

sections.heading: Why I hold it
sections.body: To reply to you, to arrange appointments, to provide your care, to send your remedies, and to keep the case records a practitioner is expected to keep. Where the information concerns your health, I hold it on the basis that it is necessary for providing health care to you, and because you have chosen to share it with me for that purpose.

sections.heading: How long I keep it
sections.body: I am required to keep patient records for 7 years. Enquiries that do not lead to an appointment are deleted once they are no longer needed.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
sections.body: An established homeopathic pharmacy prepares and posts your remedies, and receives only the information needed to do that, such as your name, address and the remedy. My email provider handles the messages we exchange. Nothing is sold, and nothing is shared for marketing.

sections.heading: This website
sections.body: This site stores two things in your own browser: your language preference and your cookie choice. There is no analytics and no tracking. What you send through the contact form goes to me and is recorded in my secure client management system so that I can reply. It is not published anywhere.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask to see the information I hold about you, to have it corrected, or to have it deleted where I am not required to keep it. Write to me and I will respond within one month. If you are not satisfied with how I have handled something, you may complain to the Information Commissioner's Office.

terms.seoTitle: Terms and Conditions | Homeopathy with Natasa
terms.seoDescription: Terms for consultations, fees, cancellations and the use of this website.
terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.standfirst: The terms on which consultations are provided.

sections.heading: Consultations
sections.body: Consultations are provided by Nataša Perić, homeopath, currently online by video, with in person appointments in Telegraph Hill, south east London, available by arrangement. Homeopathy is a complementary therapy. Booking an appointment means you accept these terms.

sections.heading: Fees and payment
sections.body: Current fees are listed on the Consultations and Pricing page. Payment is due at the time of the appointment unless we have agreed otherwise. Homeopathic medicines are included in the consultation fees, except for acute consultations and detox therapies. Postage is charged separately, from £3.50, depending on size and weight.

sections.heading: Cancellations
sections.body: Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or reschedule, or 48 hours if you have not seen me before. Late cancellations and missed appointments are charged in full. If something urgent happens, tell me. I would rather know.

sections.heading: Remedies
sections.body: Remedies are prepared by an established homeopathic pharmacy and posted to the address you give me, usually arriving within a few days. Written instructions are always included. If you are outside the UK we will agree the arrangement before your consultation.

sections.heading: Medical care
sections.body: Homeopathy does not replace medical advice or treatment. I do not diagnose, and I will never advise you to stop medication prescribed by your doctor. Please continue with your medical care and tell me about any medication you take. If something needs medical attention, I will say so.

sections.heading: Use of this website
sections.body: The content of this site is for general information and is not personal health advice. Links to other sites are provided for convenience and I am not responsible for their content. I may update these terms, and the version published here is the one that applies.

ethics.seoTitle: Code of Ethics | Homeopathy with Natasa
ethics.seoDescription: The professional standards Nataša Perić practises to, as a member of the Complementary Therapist Association.
ethics.title: Code of Ethics
ethics.standfirst: The standards I hold myself to.

sections.heading: Professional registration
sections.body: I am registered with the Complementary Therapist Association and I practise in line with its code of conduct. I hold professional insurance and I keep my registration current.

sections.heading: Confidentiality
sections.body: What you tell me stays between us. Case notes are kept securely, and your details are shared only where they are needed to send your remedy, or where the law requires me to share them. If I ever want to use an anonymised case for teaching or supervision, I will ask you first.

sections.heading: Consent
sections.body: You decide what happens. I explain what I am suggesting and why, in plain language, so you can make your own choice, and you may pause or stop at any point without needing to justify it.

sections.heading: Scope of practice
sections.body: I work as a homeopath and not as a doctor. I do not diagnose, and I never advise you to stop or change medication prescribed for you. I do not make claims about outcomes for named conditions, and I will not offer treatment that is outside what I am trained to do.

sections.heading: Honesty and uncertainty
sections.body: I do not give promises. I tell you what is realistic, and I tell you when something is uncertain or unknown. If this way of working does not seem right for you, I would rather say so early.

sections.heading: Referral
sections.body: If something you describe needs medical attention, or another practitioner would serve you better, I will say so and encourage you to go. Your safety comes before continuing with me.

sections.heading: Continuing development
sections.body: I keep learning. I teach and supervise at the Centre for Homeopathic Education in London, I take supervision myself, and I complete continuing professional development every year.

supervision.seoDescription: One-to-one and small group supervision for homeopathy students and qualified practitioners with Nataša Perić.
supervision.title: Supervision
supervision.standfirst: Since 2009 I have taught at the Centre for Homeopathic Education and supervised many undergraduate and postgraduate students. I love this side of my work as it allows me to share my knowledge and experience with student homeopaths. I deeply care about the professional and personal growth of my students, and I am grateful to be part of their journey; it is something I am truly proud of.

quotes.text: Natasa always gives careful consideration to my ideas and manages to strike a balance between challenging me and encouraging me. Our supervision sessions are interactive and collaborative, which not only improves my clinical skills, but has had a real impact on my growth, both as a person and as a homeopath.
quotes.author: Supervisee

quotes.text: Natasa became my supervisor while I was completing my BSc homeopathy training, but even now, as a qualified homeopath, I have regular supervision with her. She has an impressive knowledge of homeopathy, patient management and anatomy and physiology, and she is always willing to go the extra mile to support me.
quotes.author: Supervisee

quotes.text: I greatly appreciate Natasa's genuine warmth in dealing with some of my ups and downs as a homeopath. Her professionalism and dedication are always inspiring.
quotes.author: Supervisee

supervision.introBody:
I offer one-to-one supervision for homeopathic students, graduates and practising homeopaths.

I also offer small group supervision, where you can bring clinical cases for discussion and learn from each other in a supportive environment. Sessions are held online.
supervision.workingBody:
Supervision is an opportunity to bring your cases, questions and challenges and have the space to think them through.

My aim is to create a supportive space where you can reflect on your practice, develop your critical and clinical thinking and build confidence in your work.
supervision.contactBody: Please contact me to discuss your supervision needs and explore how we can work together.
